|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Han's Medal]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023) (PDF created 17 June 2023), cut unchanged from page 5. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Han's Medal]]): Players Committee card image first published 5 March 2023<ref name="ht-32e1135">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual21-Light/large/hansmedal.gif</code> as published 5 March 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/32e11351311a33497ffb43a1612b36c3ae669e88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/hansmedal.gif holotable commit 32e1135] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on Han or a Wookiee. Once per game, when deployed, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. If on Chewie, may place this device in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of a Wookiee here.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 5, file created 17 June 2023: “Deploy on Han or a Wookiee. Once per game, when deployed, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. If on Chewie, may place this device in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of a Wookiee here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Han's Medal]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Han's Medal]] (published 5 March 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Han’s Medal”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
